The '''Milagro system''' contained [[Milagro/Legends|Milagro]]. It was located at an important [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] junction.<ref name="TEC" />

==History==
[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Uther Kermen]] commanded the [[Milagro campaign]] of [[Milagro/Legends|Milagro]], fighting the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in a months-long siege. Eventually, Kermen destroyed much of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Milagro with a [[Base Delta Zero/Legends|Base Delta Zero]] bombardment to deny its resources to the New Republic before being forced to abandon the system.

A New Republic fleet led by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]'s [[flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[New Hope]]'' remained above the planet. Soon after, the system was visited by the damaged [[Crynyd|Purdy M. Trico's Star Destroyer]] for repairs and its convoy. [[Purdy M. Trico]] decided to [[Battle in the Milagro system|attack]] the defenseless New Republic fleet, which however was successfully thwarted by a makeshift force.<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

In the aftermath of the [[Trioculus affair]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the system was one of the hideouts of the [[New Republic Provisional Council]], based on board the ''[[New Hope]]''.<ref name="The Star Wars Spy Game: SPIN Declassified">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-spy-game-spin-declassified|text=The ''Star Wars'' Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|int=The Star Wars Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|nolive=1}}</ref>
